crossRefs.note: The poor man and the oppressor have this in common: Yahweh gives sight to the eyes of both.
Yahweh makes poor and makes rich. He brings low, he also lifts up.
Hear this, all you peoples. Listen, all you inhabitants of the world,
both low and high, rich and poor together.
“Now there was a certain rich man, and he was clothed in purple and fine linen, living in luxury every day.
A certain beggar, named Lazarus, was taken to his gate, full of sores,
The eye can’t tell the hand, “I have no need for you,” or again the head to the feet, “I have no need for you.”
For if a man with a gold ring, in fine clothing, comes into your synagogue, and a poor man in filthy clothing also…
He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for his Maker, but he who is kind to the needy honors him.
Didn’t he who made me in the womb make him? Didn’t one fashion us in the womb?
He doesn’t respect the persons of princes, nor respect the rich more than the poor; for they all are the work of his…

translations.web: The rich and the poor have this in common: Yahweh is the maker of them all.
translations.bsb: The rich and the poor have this in common: The LORD is Maker of them all.
translations.kjv: The rich and poor meet together: the LORD is the maker
translations.asv: The rich and the poor meet together: Jehovah is the maker of them all.
